name: kato
description: Talk to your development environment. Voice-native coding: navigate, understand, edit, debug, and drive your coding agent by voice.

commands.title: Kato: Setup (voice, API keys, coding agent)
Kato: Forget Repo Notes (re-explore from scratch)
Kato: Type or Paste a Message

kato.models.router.description: OpenAI model used for intent routing (fast/cheap, runs on every utterance).

kato.models.explainer.description: OpenAI model used for spoken answers and quick code explanations (kato.llm.provider = openai). gpt-5.6-luna runs with reasoning off for low TTFT.

kato.models.anthropicExplainer.description: Anthropic model used for spoken answers (kato.llm.provider = anthropic). claude-haiku-4-5 starts speaking fastest; claude-sonnet-5 is smarter.

kato.llm.provider.description: Provider for Kato's internal LLM (spoken answers). Soniox has no LLM, so this stays OpenAI or Anthropic. Takes effect on the next utterance.

kato.stt.provider.description: Speech-to-text provider. Takes effect on the next utterance.

kato.stt.model.description: OpenAI transcription model used over the Realtime API (provider: openai).

kato.stt.assemblyaiModel.description: AssemblyAI streaming model (provider: assemblyai). universal-3-5-pro code-switches Spanish/English natively.

kato.stt.silenceMs.description: Extra silence (ms) before your utterance is considered finished. Soniox: grace window after its endpoint detection — if you resume speaking within it, the utterance continues (raise this if Kato cuts you off mid-sentence). OpenAI: server VAD silence duration.

kato.stt.language.description: Optional ISO language hint for transcription (e.g. 'es', 'en'). Leave empty for auto.

kato.stt.prompt.default: The speaker is a programmer who talks in Spanish and English, often mixed. The only possible languages are Spanish and English. Technical terms, identifiers and product names stay in English.
kato.stt.prompt.description: Bias prompt for transcription (helps with Spanish/English code-switching).

kato.tts.provider.description: Text-to-speech provider. Takes effect on the next sentence.

kato.tts.voice.description: Voice for spoken responses. Run "Kato: Choose Voice" to browse the provider's catalog and audition voices instead of typing a name here.

enumDescriptions: The agent picks per question: repo-wide → sections, a file/feature → function-by-function, a single function in depth → block-by-block. Voice requests ("línea por línea", "por encima") always win.
Always block/line-level stops — line-by-line walk-through of a small piece of code (up to 12 stops).
Always one stop per function/method — detailed walk-through (up to 12 stops).
Always section-level stops — faster overview (up to 8 stops).
Claude Code: live steering mid-task, plan mode, and per-action voice approvals.
Codex: turn-based (instructions queue until the current turn ends) and sandbox-based permissions instead of voice approvals.
kato.agent.provider.description: Coding agent used for delegation (Agent mode) and deep understanding. Takes effect on the next task.

kato.agent.model.description: Model the coding agent uses (Claude Code: sonnet, opus…; Codex: gpt-5-codex…). Empty = the agent's own default.

kato.agent.cliPath.description: Path to the agent CLI binary (e.g. claude). Empty = auto-detect.

enumDescriptions: The agent's own default (Claude Code: normal).
Plan: read-only, proposes a plan first.
Manual: asks by voice before every action, edits included.
Normal: edits freely; asks only for commands that can change things (read-only commands like ls or git status never ask).
Automatic: never asks, still shows every action in the panel.
kato.agent.defaultMode.description: Permission level delegated tasks start in. Saying "ponlo en automático" / "sí a todo" by voice updates this, so the choice survives restarts.

enumDescriptions: Kato says when the agent has a plan, gives an occasional progress update on long tasks, and speaks when it needs you or finishes.
Kato only speaks when the agent needs you or finishes. Progress lives in the panel and the status bar.
kato.agent.spokenUpdates.description: How much Kato talks while the coding agent works in the background.

kato.mic.device.description: Microphone device for ffmpeg capture (avfoundation name or index on macOS). Empty = system default.

kato.tts.instructions.default: Speak fast, with an energetic and natural conversational pace, like a colleague pair-programming. Never drag words or pause dramatically. Pronounce code identifiers in English.
kato.tts.instructions.description: Style instructions passed to the TTS model (gpt-4o-mini-tts only).
